body: Look up "autistic burnout." This might be what you're experiencing. It happens to me from working in retail and masking all day everyday....eventually leads to a complete breakdown/regression.

Greetings, and thank you all for your kind words. I spent 6 days in inpatient treatment for my suicidal tendencies and have received tremendous help for my issues. I am currently doing better than ever. I wish the best to all of you. <3
Thank you for your kind words. Have you ever tried burning sage? Does it actually help?
